Backdrop.description:
A themed set behind a stage scene's props, instead of a plain built-in `background`: a real
place (photo), a web page, a market board, a phone screen or a group chat.

kind.description: photo = a full-screen photo of a place or surface (stock `query`, Wikipedia `who` for a painting/map, or your `path`), darkened so props read on it; screenshot = a web page (`url`, optional `wayback`) filling the frame; board = a dense market/departure board of `items` ('BBCA -2,1%'), tinted; phone = a phone app screen with a `title` header (pair it with notif elements); chat = a messenger group chat with a `title` (the group's name) and `info` (pair it with bubble elements).
kind.title: Kind

query.description: photo: English keywords for a place or surface, 2-4 words ('old apothecary shelves', 'vintage world map', 'trading floor').
query.title: Query

who.description: photo: a Wikipedia article whose lead image is the set (a painting, an old map, a building).
who.title: Who

brief.description: photo: the ideal backdrop in a few Indonesian words, for the photo brief.
brief.title: Brief

wayback.description: screenshot: the Wayback Machine copy from this date (YYYY or YYYYMMDD).
wayback.title: Wayback

items.description: board: 4-40 short cells ('BBCA -2,1%', 'GOTO +4,8%', 'CGK 09.40'); a '-' / '+' number colours the cell red / green. Repeated to fill.
items.title: Items

title.description: phone: the small header line ('autodebet · tgl 5 Jan'); board: an optional header ('IDX · 15 Okt 2026'); chat: the group's name ('Keluarga Besar').
title.title: Title

info.description: chat: the small line under the name ('23 anggota', 'online').
info.title: Info

dim.description: How much the set is darkened (0-0.9); unset = klip.yaml stage.backdrop.<kind>.dim.
dim.title: Dim

blur.description: photo/screenshot: blur in px; unset = the kind's default.
blur.title: Blur

tint.description: A colour wash over the set, e.g. '#7A0F14' (a red market crash); unset = none.
tint.title: Tint

tone.description: Whether the set reads as light or dark (title and tag colours); unset = the kind's default.
tone.title: Tone

Backdrop.title: Backdrop

Beat.description: A new shot inside a stock scene, cut in on a narration word with its own clip.

at.description: Narration word (or phrase; its first word counts) where this shot starts: the cut lands as the voice says it.
at.title: At

query.description: English keywords for this shot's stock clip.
query.title: Query

Beat.title: Beat

start.description: First x value of the shaded span (same form as the data's x).
start.title: Start

end.description: Last x value of the span.
end.title: End

label.description: Short text in the band, e.g. 'SBY'.
label.title: Label

x.description: X value as shown/compared: an ISO date ('2024-10-16') or a label ('2019').
x.title: X

CodeScene.description:
A scene whose look and motion are code Claude writes (see docs/CODE-SCENES.md): markup, <style>
and one <script> that animates on the scene kit `k` (a GSAP timeline at the scene's start, the
narration's word times, the look bible).

assets.description: Repo-relative files the scene uses (images, SVGs); reference them as '@asset/<file name>' in markup, CSS or JS.
assets.title: Assets

include.description: Repo-relative .js files run before the scene's script, inside it (with `k`): helpers and motifs shared by several scenes.
include.title: Include

captions.description: false = no captions on this scene (it shows its own words, e.g. kinetic type).
captions.title: Captions

texture.description: This scene's texture instead of the look bible's.
texture.title: Texture

sfx.description: Sound effects on this scene's own beats (the stamp, the bar filling, the pop), on top of the automatic cut whoosh.
sfx.title: Sfx

CodeScene.title: CodeScene

CodeSfx.description: A sound effect on a code scene's beat.

at.description: Narration word (or phrase) the effect lands on, as in k.at().
at.title: At

sfx.description: Effect name: a file in klip.yaml sfx.dir (whoosh, pop, ding, riser, hit).
sfx.title: Sfx

offset_s.description: Shift from the word (s); a riser that should END on the word takes about -1.
offset_s.title: Offset S

CodeSfx.title: CodeSfx

lines.description: Title as 2-3 explicit lines; the last line is the keyword (bigger, accent colour). Use this or title + keyword.
lines.title: Lines

title.description: Title lead-in (3-5 words, wraps to max 2 lines), e.g. 'Kenapa Kita Ikut Ikutan'.
title.title: Title

keyword.description: The payoff word(s) shown big as the last line, e.g. 'Menguap?'.
keyword.title: Keyword

subtitle.description: One short sentence under the title, e.g. 'Ternyata bukan karena bosan'.
subtitle.title: Subtitle

layout.description: hero = short title on top, a big subject (cut-out photo and/or mascot) below; text = title only. Unset: hero whenever there is a subject.
layout.title: Layout

image.description: Hero photo path (relative to the repo), cut out as a sticker. Unset: <photos dir>/<slug>/cover.*, the hook's stage cut-out, another scene's, else the subject lifted from the hook's b-roll.
image.title: Image

mascot.description: Mascot pose on the cover (e.g. 'kaget', 'bingung'), or 'none'. Unset: klip.yaml cover.hero.mascot_pose.
mascot.title: Mascot

who.description: Which cast member is on the cover. Unset: the hook's speaker.
who.title: Who

badge.description: 1-2 word sticker on the hero, e.g. 'MITOS?', '1 DETIK', '350 TAHUN'. Teases, never answers.
badge.title: Badge

HookVariant.description: An alternative first scene for A/B testing; unset fields keep the main hook's.
HookVariant.title: HookVariant

LookBible.description:
Art direction shared by every code scene so the video reads as one film. Unset fields come from
the style's look_bible (brand pack), then klip.yaml code.look.

preset.description: A named look to start from (klip.yaml code.looks, e.g. 'cinematic': dark, hairline, glowing accent, film grain). The fields below override it.
preset.title: Preset

palette.description: Named colours ('bg', 'ink', 'accent', 'paper', 'sky', …) → CSS vars --k-<name> and k.look.palette. 'bg' fills the scene.
palette.title: Palette

texture.description: Overlay on every code scene: paper (fibres + vignette), watercolor (wash blotches), halftone (dot screen), grain (film grain), hud (scanlines + corner marks), riso (misprint grain), film (grain + dark vignette, for dark looks), none.
texture.title: Texture

line.description: Stroke width (px) for drawn art: k.look.line.
line.title: Line

notes.description: Art direction in prose for whoever writes the scenes (style, characters, camera, motifs). Not rendered.
notes.title: Notes

LookBible.title: LookBible

MascotPose.description: A mascot changes pose (expression) on a narration word.

who.description: Mascot name from the style's mascot cast, e.g. 'napa'.
who.title: Who

pose.description: Pose file name in that mascot's folder, e.g. 'kaget', 'paham', 'kepo', 'bingung', 'tunjuk'.
pose.title: Pose

at.description: Narration word where the pose starts; unset = the scene's start.
at.title: At

hold_s.description: Back to the neutral pose after this long; unset = until the next pose or the scene's end.
hold_s.title: Hold S

MascotPose.title: MascotPose

MotionStep.description: One beat of a motion component (see StageElement.steps).

text.description: kinetic: the phrase; split/flow/funnel: the part's name; meter: a short caption for this level; cycle: the step; timeline: the event; reel: an option.
text.title: Text

at.description: Narration word where this step plays (after the element's own `at`, in order). Unset = shortly after the previous step.
at.title: At

value.description: split/flow/funnel: the amount (sizes the part); meter: the fill level (≤ the element's `max`).
value.title: Value

show.description: The value as shown, e.g. 'Rp96rb', '96%', '1,2 jt'; counts up when it's a number. Unset: split shows the share in %, flow/funnel the plain value.
show.title: Show

label.description: timeline: the date ('2014', 'Mar 2020'); others: a small line under the step.
label.title: Label

name.description: Lucide icon for the step (flow/cycle/timeline/funnel nodes).
name.title: Name

accent.description: Highlight this step (kinetic phrase, split/flow part, funnel layer); reel: the option the reel lands on (exactly one).
accent.title: Accent

MotionStep.title: MotionStep

mood.description: Picks a track from assets/music/<mood>/; null = no music.
mood.title: Mood

beats.description: Code scenes follow the track's beats (k.beats, k.pulse). Turn off for a track without a steady beat (ambient, orchestral swells).
beats.title: Beats

narration.description: Spoken text; also what captions display.
narration.title: Narration

tts_override.description: Optional spoken version, e.g. 'wai fai' for 'WiFi'.
tts_override.title: Tts Override

emphasis.description: Words/phrases to color with the emphasis color.
emphasis.title: Emphasis

voice.description: This scene's narrator when it differs from the video's `voice` (a dialogue: alternate male and female). Unset = the voice of the scene's mascot speaker if one is set, else the video's voice.
voice.title: Voice

transition.description: The cut into this scene; unset = picked from the style's transitions pool.
transition.title: Transition

delivery.description: Voice style for this scene (rate/pitch preset in klip.yaml prosody); unset = by template.
delivery.title: Delivery

list_index.description: list_item: number shown; auto-numbered if unset.
list_index.title: List Index

list_total.description: list_item: total shown ('1/3'); auto if unset.
list_total.title: List Total

reveal_at.description: myth_fact: narration word at which the fact card appears (default: ~45% into the scene).
reveal_at.title: Reveal At

mascot.description: Mascots (only when the style has a mascot cast): who speaks and pose changes.

cta_type.description: cta: what the outro asks for; shows an action chip (icon + label). 'comment' = on_screen_text is a two-sided question shown as the headline.
cta_type.title: Cta Type

SceneMascot.description: The style's mascots (a brand pack's cast) in this scene.

speaker.description: Who speaks this scene's narration (mouth moves with the words); unset = the style's default for the template; 'none' = nobody.
speaker.title: Speaker

poses.description: Pose changes in narration order (on top of automatic reactions).
poses.title: Poses

show.description: Only these mascots appear in this scene (e.g. ['napa'] to introduce one); unset = all of the video's mascots.
show.title: Show

scale.description: Mascot size in this scene (2 = twice as tall, for a scene about the mascots themselves); the props area shrinks to make room.
scale.title: Scale

focus.description: Spotlight: this mascot (true = the scene's speaker) steps to the centre, big, under a spotlight, and the others leave for the scene. For a hook, a punchline or a reaction; the props area is only a strip above it (0-1 small props, or a label).
focus.title: Focus

SceneMascot.title: SceneMascot

text.description: One short line under the title.
text.title: Text

label.description: Bar label under the bar, e.g. '2023'.
label.title: Label

value.description: Bar height (bars are scaled to the largest).
value.title: Value

text.description: Value shown on top of the bar, e.g. 'Rp12rb'; unset = no text.
text.title: Text

StageElement.description: A prop that builds up on a stage scene: it pops in as the voice says `at` and stays.

at.description: Narration word (or phrase; its first word counts) where this element pops in. Elements are matched in narration order.
at.title: At

kind.description: cutout = stock photo with its background removed (a sticker); photo = photo card; icon = Lucide icon on a sticker disc; label = paper tag; number = big number; bar = bar chart; stack = a pile of `count` icons; highlight = yellow box around an earlier element; stamp = a rubber stamp that thumps down (a verdict: 'BERHASIL', 'PALSU'); chart = a line chart that draws on (real data: points, csv or ticker); unit = a grid of `total` squares, `filled` of them highlighted; person = a real person's card (Wikipedia photo of `who`, name, a line, a stat); news = a headline card (outlet, date, text); logo = an organisation's logo (`who`) on a sign; screenshot = a web page (`url`) in a browser window; notif = a phone notification card (`outlet` = the app, `text` = the line, `stat` = a big amount, `date` = the corner note); bubble = a chat message on a chat backdrop (`sender`, `text`, `me`, `forwarded`, `date` = the time), stacking down the chat and scrolling it like a real one. Motion components (animated diagrams; their `steps` play on their own words): kinetic = big kinetic type, one phrase per step; split = a whole that breaks into shares (step values); flow = amounts flowing from a source (`text`, `name`) to 1-4 destinations; meter = a gauge filling to each step's value out of `max`, with a counter; cycle = a loop of 3-6 steps with a dot going round (a vicious circle); timeline = dated events (step `label` = the date); funnel = layers narrowing step by step; reel = a slot reel spinning through options and landing on the `accent` one.
kind.title: Kind

query.description: cutout/photo: English keywords for the stock photo, naming one object or person (e.g. 'tempeh block', 'businessman shrugging').
query.title: Query

path.description: cutout/photo/person/logo: your own image instead of `query` / `who` (a transparent PNG is used as-is).
path.title: Path

who.description: person/logo/cutout/photo: the Wikipedia article title of a real person or organisation (e.g. 'Joko Widodo', 'SoftBank Group'); its lead image is used, with the licence in the credits.
who.title: Who

name.description: icon/stack: Lucide icon name, e.g. 'coins'. cutout/photo: an icon shown instead when no photo is found. flow/meter: the source / gauge icon.
name.title: Name

brief.description: cutout/photo/person/logo: the ideal photo in a few words, in Indonesian, for the photo brief the user may shoot or find ('tangan memegang HP dengan aplikasi slot, malam hari').
brief.title: Brief

own.description: cutout/photo/person/logo: this prop must be exactly right (a local product, a specific place): always listed in the photo brief; stock is only a placeholder until the user's photo is in the photo folder.
own.title: Own

text.description: label: the tag text (1-4 words); number: the number as shown, e.g. '-7%' or 'Rp12.000'; stamp: 1-2 words; chart: its title ('IHSG'); unit: the legend ('1 kotak = 1.000 alat'); person: one small line ('2014–2024'); news: the headline; flow: the source ('Rp100rb'); meter: what's measured ('Uang hilang'); cycle: the centre; split/reel/funnel: an optional title.
text.title: Text

label.description: cutout/photo/icon/logo/screenshot: a short tag stuck under the element; person: the name (default: from `who`).
label.title: Label

tone.description: number/stamp/person stat/chart line: colour (up = green, down = red; a neutral chart follows its trend).
tone.title: Tone

csv.description: chart: repo-relative CSV with a header; first column x, second y.
csv.title: Csv

ticker.description: chart: a Yahoo Finance symbol, e.g. '^JKSE' (IHSG), 'BBCA.JK', 'IDR=X' (USD/IDR); needs `start`.
ticker.title: Ticker

end.description: chart ticker: last date, YYYY-MM-DD (unset = today).
end.title: End

bands.description: chart: shaded spans with a label (eras, terms of office).
bands.title: Bands

filled.description: unit: how many are highlighted (default all).
filled.title: Filled

outlet.description: news: the outlet, e.g. 'Katadata'; notif: the app name ('m-banking', 'Shopee').
outlet.title: Outlet

date.description: news: the date as shown, e.g. 'Jumat, 16 Okt 2026'; notif: the corner note ('bulan ke-12', '09.41'); bubble: the time ('19.02').
date.title: Date

sender.description: bubble: who sent it, as the chat shows the name ('Om Hendra', 'Tante Rina'); never a real person's name or number.
sender.title: Sender

me.description: bubble: sent by the phone's owner (right side, the sent colour).
me.title: Me

wayback.description: screenshot: capture the Wayback Machine copy from this date (YYYY or YYYYMMDD), for pages as they looked back then.
wayback.title: Wayback

selector.description: screenshot: CSS selector of the part to capture (unset = the top of the page).
selector.title: Selector

stat.description: person: a short stat under the name, e.g. '+499,50%'; notif: the big amount ('Rp4,54 jt').
stat.title: Stat

steps.description: Motion components: the beats, in narration order.
steps.title: Steps

count.description: stack: how many icons pile up (default 4).
count.title: Count

target.description: highlight: number (1-based) of the earlier element in this scene to box.
target.title: Target

pos.description: Slot on the stage: t/m/b (top/middle/bottom) + l/c/r. Unset = automatic layout.
pos.title: Pos

size.description: Unset = by how many elements share the stage.
size.title: Size

clear.description: Clear the stage (earlier elements leave) before this one enters.
clear.title: Clear

StageElement.title: StageElement

value.description: Number the counter animates to, e.g. 34 or 1.5.
value.title: Value

suffix.description: Shown after the number, e.g. '%' or ' menit'.
suffix.title: Suffix

label.description: Line under the number; defaults to on_screen_text.
label.title: Label

query.description: English keywords for stock search (the scene's first shot).
query.title: Query

beats.description: Later shots of this scene, in narration order, each cut in on a word with its own clip. Preferred over `queries`.
beats.title: Beats

queries.description: Legacy: extra English queries for later shots, cut on a timer. Use `beats` instead.
queries.title: Queries

max_shots.description: Cap the cuts in this scene; 1 = a single shot.
max_shots.title: Max Shots

background.description: type=stage: 'grid' (dot-grid paper), 'studio' (wall over a light desk), 'spotlight' (dark desk under a light), or the older 'desk', 'paper', 'kraft', 'board' (see klip.yaml stage.backgrounds), or a repo-relative image path. Unset = stage.default_background.
background.title: Background

backdrop.description: type=stage: a themed set instead of `background` (a real place, a web page, a market board, a phone screen, a group chat). Vary sets across the video as the story moves.

elements.description: type=stage: props that build up on the background, each popping in on its narration word, in narration order.
elements.title: Elements

code.description: type=code: the scene file and its options.

World.description:
One code layer under a run of consecutive code scenes (see docs/CODE-SCENES.md, "One world"): a single
picture the camera travels through while the scenes change on top, instead of a cut per scene. Its
`k` spans the run: k.words / k.at cover every scene's narration, k.scenes says when each one plays.

scenes.description: Ids of the consecutive code scenes it runs under; empty = every code scene (they must be consecutive).
scenes.title: Scenes

World.title: World

speech_rate.description: e.g. '+8%'. Unset = per-voice default in klip.yaml.
speech_rate.title: Speech Rate

series.description: Series key, e.g. 'kenapa'; shown as a pill (label from the style's series_pill.labels, else the key in capitals).
series.title: Series

episode.description: Episode number shown on the series pill ('#12').
episode.title: Episode

look.description: 'stage' = illustrated explainer look: most hook/explain/list_item scenes use visual.type 'stage' (share in klip.yaml stage.look_min_share). 'mixed' = pick per scene.
look.title: Look

look_bible.description: Art direction for code scenes (palette, fonts, texture, motion); unset = the style's.

world.description: One code layer the camera travels through under a run of consecutive code scenes (their own bg turns transparent).

mascots.description: Which of the style's mascots appear: unset/true = the whole cast, false = none, or a list of names (e.g. ['napa']).
mascots.title: Mascots

progress_bar.description: Thin progress bar at the top; unset = the style's setting. Set false/true to A/B test it.
progress_bar.title: Progress Bar

loop.description: End on the first frame so the auto-replay is seamless; unset = the style's loop.enabled.
loop.title: Loop

save_nudge.description: 'Simpan dulu' pill when the 2nd list_item starts; unset = the style's save_nudge.enabled.
save_nudge.title: Save Nudge

cover.description: Designed cover.png (profile grid thumbnail); unset = built from the hook's on_screen_text (emphasised end = keyword).

sfx.description: Sound effects on cuts, reveals, badges (see klip.yaml sfx).
sfx.title: Sfx

hook_variants.description: Alternative hooks (scene 1) for A/B testing; `klip render --variants` renders each.
hook_variants.title: Hook Variants
